title: Long time no see
description: Two old friends meet by chance at a bus stop and make plans.
sceneSummary: Two old friends, Liya and Dawit, meet by chance at a city bus stop after a long time apart. They ask how each other has been, talk about Liya's new job and Dawit studying English, and agree to catch up at the weekend.
